headline: Sarkozy and Carla Bruni ordered to stand trial
pages: Former French president Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife, Carla Bruni-Sarkozy, will face trial next year over the retraction of testimony by a key witness in the Libya campaign funding case. The witness, Libyan businessman Ziad Takieddine, had said he held written proof that Libya financed Sarkozy's 2007 campaign. Both deny wrongdoing. Sarkozy was sentenced to five years in the main case last September and became the first French ex-president to go to jail, though he spent only 20 days behind bars. The appeal verdict in that case is expected next Monday. He has faced several other convictions since losing the 2012 election, including for bribing a judge and for illegal campaign financing.
